name: zc_fire

tests.name: arden_infernal: the skin carries flame parts, and a surface to draw them on

detail.note: parts tagged twinkle become Part_<name>; RebuildFlames lays ribbons into FlameSurface

tests.name: arden_infernal: every tongue of flame moves

detail.note: Tall runs 0.70-1.36 by design, so a burning tongue swings well past 0.25

tests.name: arden_infernal: a tongue goes tall and thin, it does not swell in place

detail.note: width against height, same frames; a uniformly scaling tuft would read +1.0

tests.name: arden_infernal: the flicker has not collapsed into a loop

detail.note: highest self-correlation past 0.2 s. A pure loop reads ~1.0; three summed octaves sit at 0.85-0.94 by construction, and this bar was 0.9 until the same code measured 0.857 and 0.936 on different runs

tests.name: arden_infernal: neighbouring tongues do not flicker together

detail.note: seeded per part, so the whole never pulses as one object

tests.name: arden_infernal: the fire travels with the Dog

detail.note: the Dog is teleported; a flame parented anywhere else would be left behind

tests.name: arden_infernal: the flame ribbons are drawn with a material

detail.note: one section per ember colour the skin burns in
